title: Nachiketa ne Yamraj se kya maanga?
hooks: Ek 12 saal ke ladke ne Mrityu ko apna mehman bana liya
Teen din bina khaaye-pie Yamraj ke dwar pe kaun rukta hai?
Pita ne daan mein bete ko Mrityu ko de diya
hook_why: Specific age + personified Death as 'guest' creates instant curiosity gap; reframes a heavy myth into a relatable 'what would you do' moment
metaphor: A single diya burning steady in a vast dark palace — the individual soul (Atman) lighting up the mansion of death

cast.Nachiketa: Young boy, 12-14 years, simple cotton dhoti, shaved head with single sikha, calm determined eyes, hands folded but spine straight
cast.Yamraj: Tall majestic figure, deep bronze skin, dark red dhoti with gold border, crown of rudraksha, eyes like burning coals yet compassionate, four arms hinted by shadow, black buffalo in deep background
cast.Vajashrava: Middle-aged rishi, white beard, saffron robes, performing fire sacrifice, face shifting from pride to regret

caption:
12 saal ke Nachiketa ne Mrityu ko hi apna guru bana liya. Katha Upanishad ki ye baat aaj bhi hila deti hai. 🕉️

Srot: Katha Upanishad, Pratham Valli

claims.claim: Nachiketa story appears in Katha Upanishad, Pratham Valli (First Chapter)
claims.basis: Katha Upanishad, one of the principal Upanishads, Krishna Yajurveda

claims.claim: Nachiketa asked for three boons from Yamraj
Third boon was knowledge of what happens after death (Atman)
Yamraj initially offered wealth, kingdom, pleasures to divert Nachiketa
Nachiketa rejected transient pleasures for eternal knowledge

story_fixed: 19 Nov: scene 1 + 5 corrected against Katha Upanishad 1.1 (Nachiketa is Yama's guest; three nights without food)
